identity: ONE original stocky armoured knight, the Warrant Anvil veteran, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter view. Keep the soot-black iron plate armour with worn bronze trim, the closed barred bronze helmet, the cream tabard with a small scales emblem and the chain-hung brass tags at the belt, and the heavy armoured boots. Exactly two arms, two hands and two legs. The screen-LEFT hand holds ONE short square-headed stamped hammer; the screen-RIGHT arm carries ONE tall black and bronze tower shield with a round pressure-gauge dial near the top, a small winged emblem above it and a long cream warrant parchment with a red wax seal hanging down its face. Preserve the hammer, the shield with its gauge and warrant, and the stocky proportions.
plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the full helmet, hammer, shield, limbs and boots within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated BLUE throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The blue background stays the same flat saturated blue in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, additional weapons, sparks, motion trails, particles or extra limbs. Articulate joints naturally with physical planted-foot support; the shield stays rigid and never morphs.

idle_h3_v1.action: A stern, watchful idle that loops. The knight breathes, the shoulders rise and fall, the hammer hand turns the hammer a little, the shield settles on the arm and the helmet turns slightly to scan, then everything returns smoothly to the original stance. Both boots stay planted. No walking and no attack.

move_h3_v1.action: March in place through two complete reciprocal cycles with short heavy steps. Alternate near and far legs through forward contact, weight loading, passing and lift; both knees articulate and each boot alternates taking weight and swinging. The torso stays centred for engine-driven travel. The shield stays upright on the arm and the hammer swings a little at the side; the warrant parchment sways. Finish in the original gait phase.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE overhead hammer blow toward screen right. The knight raises the hammer high above the helmet as the knees bend, then steps into a deep lunge and swings the hammer down and forward to full reach at screen right, the shield held close, pulls back and settles into the original stance. One blow only; no sparks or effect at contact.

hit_h3_v1.action: The knight starts rocked back in a flinch and recovers from it. The helmet and shoulders hunch, the shield rocks back and the knees flex deep while both hands keep hold of the hammer and the shield, then the knight straightens, rebalances on both boots and returns to the same stance. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

defend_h3_v1.action: Crouch low behind the tower shield, setting it forward and angled in front of the body with the shoulder braced against it and the hammer drawn in, then hold the braced guard on both planted boots. No attack and no return to the relaxed stance.

cast_h3_v1.action: A decree. The knight raises the hammer and points it straight forward at screen right at arm's length as if pronouncing a sentence, holds the pose briefly, then lowers it back to the original stance. A physical gesture only: no spell, glow or aura.

death_h3_v1.action: Collapse slowly and heavily from standing. The knight doubles over and sinks onto both knees, leaning on the shield, stays kneeling a moment, then topples forward and lies flat on the ground, finishing motionless with the helmet at screen right, the shield lying flat beside the body and the hammer on the ground at screen left. The body never leaves the ground; no recovery, no floating equipment and no disappearing body.
